title: Final Position Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The position of the earth when the pulse bounces off must be correctly calculated as -6 x 10^9 m.

title: Final Velocity Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The velocity of the spaceship relative to the earth must be correctly determined as 10^8 m/s.

title: Final Ship Position Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The position of the ship in the earth frame at the time of signal reception must be correctly calculated as 8.5 x 10^9 m.

title: Doppler Effect Application
description: Important Criteria: The application of the Doppler effect and the use of the frequency relationship must be correctly shown.

title: Time Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of time taken for the radar pulse to reach the earth must be accurately performed.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly applied throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in the calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all necessary factors, such as gamma, are included in the calculations.
